title: Arkret Signal Envelope
description: Encrypted-only broadcast signal envelope. Exact product payload type and target are inside encrypted_payload. This object is never a durable Event and never advances actor_seq, Seal coverage, state_root, or reducer state.

expires_at.description: Semantic validation requires sent_at < expires_at and a class-specific TTL no greater than 120s for setup, 60s for moderation, and 30s for session.

encrypted_payload.description: AEAD ciphertext. The immutable outer header digest is bound into AAD; exact payload kind, product target, and sender sequence exist only in plaintext after recipient decryption. The scheme names the construction, never the algorithm: aead_profile carries the algorithm and MUST equal the active MLS ciphersuite the group at key_ref.group_state_ref actually negotiated (zh/conformance/encoding.md section 10.1). Activating a further ciphersuite therefore reaches Signal with no wire change.

group_state_ref.description: Accepted ak.mls.genesis / winning ak.mls.commit for the scope's MLS group, or an equivalent group state proof hash. It is what fixes which ciphersuite aead_profile must equal.

purpose.description: AEAD purpose for this domain. It is a nonce-derivation and AAD input, so it keeps a Signal nonce from colliding with a content-encryption nonce under the same key and epoch.

aead_profile.description: canonical_id of an active row of artifacts/registry/mls-ciphersuite-registry.json. It MUST equal the ciphersuite the group at key_ref.group_state_ref actually negotiated; a reserved suite, an unregistered suite, or a mismatch MUST fail closed.

signal_proof.description: Detached device proof over canonical_json({context:'ak.signal_proof.v1', envelope_digest, sender_actor_id, sender_device_id, verification_method, created_at, domain?, audience?}). envelope_digest hashes the complete SignalEnvelope with proof removed; created_at MUST equal the outer sent_at.

verification_method.description: The DID URL bare DID component MUST project through its registered adapter to the signing principal component of sender_actor_id (account_id.principal_id for account), and its fragment MUST equal sender_device_id; constructing it by appending to did_core_id is forbidden. This projection does not establish the Station component or authorize a device: the verifier MUST resolve the authoritative verify key for the complete (sender_actor_id, sender_device_id) from its own current accepted device directory, which is a state domain seal_ref does not select (zh/sync/signal.md section 1).
